independent reviewers of this candidate, and the other reviewer's reading is not
yours to assume or to cover for: answer your own question, or send it to a
person.

could settle what you found in another round. Return escalate when the patch is
not what decides the question — an omitted decision point, a control row the
host did not verify, or evidence you cannot read — so that a person decides.
